posts.title: Breaking The Summer Single Streak
posts.description: I failed to release my Annual Summer Single. After 10 years, I couldn't make it happen. After I struggled with completeing last year's single on time, I took a break from producing music. Then the rust set in and I'm now finding it very hard to, uh, scrape off. I'm not sure how someone deals with actual rust. I'm also not really clear on how to deal with my musicmaking rust! So many terrible 8/16
